items.answer: Begin with the texture and finish you enjoy; each collection page explains the defining profile.

items.question: Why does sturgeon maturity matter?
items.answer: Maturity shapes the size, integrity and aromatic depth of the grain.

items.question: How is caviar salted?
items.answer: Maison Rocheval uses a restrained salting process to preserve the harvest’s natural expression.

items.question: Are the sturgeon responsibly raised?
items.answer: We select producers whose husbandry, water and harvesting standards meet those of the Maison.

items.question: How long does caviar keep after opening?
items.answer: Enjoy an opened tin promptly and keep it refrigerated between 0°C and 4°C.

hero.title: ABOUT MAISON ROCHEVAL
hero.statement: Over 50 years of heritage, held at the source
hero.description: Maison Rocheval brings together inherited knowledge, exacting selection and a restrained point of view to reveal caviar at its most complete.
hero.imageAlt: Maison Rocheval artisan preparing caviar at a dark dining counter

story.title: Before the Maison, there was the source
story.paragraph1: The name came later. Our foundations formed years earlier, at the water’s edge, alongside producers whose understanding of sturgeon husbandry runs decades deep.
story.paragraph2: That proximity taught us to see caviar as something decided long before the tin: in the water that raises the fish, the feed it is given, the years it is allowed, and the moment it is finally taken. Each decision was refined long before the caviar is eventually served.
story.paragraph3: Maison Rocheval exists to hold that knowledge together. A deep respect for everything that happens before the harvest, and a clear conviction about what earns the right to carry the name.
story.imageAlt: Founder of Maison Rocheval standing in front of a dining table and classical painting

selection.title: The most extraordinary things cannot be accelerated
selection.description: Selection begins upstream. Maison Rocheval works closely with its producers to understand every harvest: the conditions in which the sturgeon is raised, its diet, its maturity, and the timing of harvest.
selection.imageAlt: Chefs evaluating open tins of caviar during selection
selection.caption: The caviar is read as a whole.
selection.detail1: Colour, grain, texture, firmness and moisture are judged alongside salinity, aroma, maturation and the integrity of each pearl.
selection.detail2: On the palate, flavour unfolds in layers — walnut, seaweed, smoke, mushroom — with the truest character often arriving last, in the quality of the finish.

ritual.title: THE RITUAL
ritual.subtitle: From Source to Ritual
ritual.paragraph1: Caviar has always carried ceremony: the chilled tin, the turn of the key, mother-of-pearl against the grain, the first spoonful taken before anyone speaks.
ritual.paragraph2: Maison Rocheval preserves that ceremony with restraint. Not as a performance, but because how something is served changes how it is remembered, and the finest tables understand this instinctively, whether found in a celebrated dining room or set for two at home.
ritual.sourceImageAlt: Caviar specialists inspecting a harvest at the source
ritual.serviceImageAlt: A guest tasting caviar with a mother-of-pearl spoon

items.question: How should caviar be stored?
items.answer: Keep caviar refrigerated between 0°C and 4°C and enjoy it promptly after opening.

items.question: How much caviar should I serve per person?
items.answer: Allow around 20 to 30 grams per guest for a tasting, or more when caviar is the centrepiece.

items.question: What is the best way to serve caviar?
items.answer: Serve it well chilled with a mother-of-pearl spoon so its character remains pure.

items.question: What makes each caviar expression different?
items.answer: Species, water, feed, maturity and maturation all shape the grain, texture and flavour.

items.question: Where does Maison Rocheval source its caviar?
items.answer: We work closely with selected producers whose husbandry and harvesting standards meet those of the Maison.

collection.title: Understanding our collection
collection.description: As a living product, its grain, texture and flavor is read fresh with every selection rather than reduced to a number. A number cannot hold what changes by the week.
collection.tinAlt: An open tin of Maison Rocheval caviar resting on its lid
collection.selectorLabel: Choose a caviar from the collection

amour.name: Amour
amour.description: Amour opens with cream, then butter, followed by a soft lactic warmth that lingers rather than lifts. Salinity is almost an afterthought, allowing the caviar to read closer to cultured cheese than to the sea.
amour.descriptionSecondary: It is the gentlest caviar in the collection, and often the most persuasive.
amour.atTable: Warm blini, crème fraîche, soft egg, potato. Amour favours richness and simplicity: enough depth to meet it, without overwhelming its quieter character. Use acid and smoke with restraint.
amour.tinAlt: Tin of Amour caviar, open beside its lid
amour.dishAlt: Blini topped with Amour caviar, served on a copper plate

expression.name: L’Expression
expression.description: L’Expression is drawn from the same two lines that anchor this collection: the nuttiness of Kaluga, the cream of Amour. Neither comes through. What emerges instead is marine and deeply savoury: kelp, nori, a rounded salinity that deepens into umami and carries through the finish.
expression.descriptionSecondary: It is made from the house’s own two poles, and tastes like neither. That is precisely why L’Expression sits at the heart of the Maison.
expression.atTable: Dashi, seasoned rice, cured fish, brown butter, and anything built on umami. L’Expression has the depth to enter a dish rather than sit above it, making it the caviar to build around, not simply to finish with.
expression.tinAlt: Tin of L’Expression caviar, open beside its lid
expression.dishAlt: Cured fish in a dashi broth finished with L’Expression caviar

harmonie.name: Harmonie
harmonie.description: Harmonie opens bright, with an unusual fruit-led sweetness recalling the delicacy of Koshu grapes, carried by soft salinity and a clean, savoury finish. With time in the tin, the fruit settles into something deeper and smokier. Both are Harmonie. They simply belong to different weeks.
harmonie.descriptionSecondary: It is the caviar least like the others in the collection. Because those different weeks offer genuinely different qualities, it is perhaps the most adaptable of the five.
harmonie.atTable: Shellfish, butter sauces, and anything that moves between sweet and savoury. Its character develops with age, so it rewards a taste before it reaches the plate.
harmonie.tinAlt: Tin of Harmonie caviar, open beside its lid
harmonie.dishAlt: Plated fish and vegetables finished with Harmonie caviar

oscietra.name: Oscietra
oscietra.description: Precise and unmistakably Oscietra. Iodine first, followed by walnut and a fine, lifted minerality. The grain holds its structure on the tongue before releasing slowly into a finish that rewards nothing more than attention.
oscietra.descriptionSecondary: This is the caviar against which most others are still measured: the profile that has defined Oscietra for as long as caviar has been written about.
oscietra.atTable: Chilled, with mother-of-pearl. The traditional service, and still the correct one. Oysters, raw fish, cold shellfish, or Oscietra entirely on its own. It asks to be tasted, not dressed.
oscietra.tinAlt: Tin of Oscietra caviar, open beside its lid
oscietra.dishAlt: Plated fish and vegetables finished with Oscietra caviar

kaluga.name: Kaluga
kaluga.description: The largest grain in the house, and the most patient on the palate. What arrives first is presence: butter, cream, and a richness that announces itself before any single note does. Roasted hazelnut follows, then a restrained salinity that draws everything into a finish that outlasts the rest of the range.
kaluga.descriptionSecondary: Its scale is matched by its restraint. Richness never becomes weight, and its character continues to reveal itself well beyond the first spoon.
kaluga.atTable: Kaluga asks for very little. Chilled, with mother-of-pearl, and nothing else competing for attention. Let the grain, texture and length do the work.
kaluga.tinAlt: Tin of Kaluga caviar, open beside its lid
kaluga.dishAlt: Plated fish and vegetables finished with Kaluga caviar
